summary.en: Miki Fujino is found strangled at the park. Takagi then finds a stamp card on the ground next to the victim's body and realises it doesn't belong to the victim as she has one in her purse. They then decide to do a stakeout the next day.

suspects: Café Wheat and Beans customers and staffs
suspectsZh: 「麦与豆」咖啡厅的客人与店员
